checks.title: The Terraform plan Checkov scanned (a proposed change) fails no Checkov check
checks.scope: A Checkov report whose check_type is terraform_plan: every Checkov check that ran, not only the mapped ones; a plan is the change about to be applied, so a clean scan of it is a test of that change before implementation. It shows the change was tested only if the pipeline runs it before every apply.
